request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBACT04C-002: Account balance update with accumulated interest at account break

### given[0]: Each calculated monthly interest amount is added to an interest total for the account. The total holds 9 integer digits and 2 decimals, signed.
fields=['WS-MONTHLY-INT', 'WS-TOTAL-INT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   463 
   464            COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT
   465             = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200
   466 
>> 467            ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT  TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   468            PERFORM 1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   469 
   470            EXIT.
   471 
CBACT04C.cbl:
   165            06 DB2-REST                  PIC X(04).
   166        01 WS-MISC-VARS.
   167            05 WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM          PIC X(11) VALUE SPACES.
   168            05 WS-MONTHLY-INT            PIC S9(09)V99.
>> 169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
   170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.
   172            05 WS-RECORD-COUNT           PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   173            05 WS-TRANID-SUFFIX          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.

### when[0]: 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT runs when a record for a new account arrives and it is not the first account group.
fields=['TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM', 'WS-FIRST-TIME'] literals=['Y']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
   191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
>> 194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
>> 195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
>> 196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   197                        ELSE
   198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
   199                        END-IF
   200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT

### then[0]: The account's interest total is added to its current balance (signed, 10 integer digits and 2 decimals).
fields=['WS-TOTAL-INT', 'ACCT-CURR-BAL'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   348            EXIT.
   349       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   350        1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT.
   351       * Update the balances in account record to reflect posted trans.
>> 352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
   353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   355 
   356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     3       *****************************************************************
     4        01  ACCOUNT-RECORD.
     5            05  ACCT-ID                           PIC 9(11).
     6            05  ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS                PIC X(01).
>>   7            05  ACCT-CURR-BAL                     PIC S9(10)V99.
     8            05  ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT                 PIC S9(10)V99.
     9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.
    10            05  ACCT-OPEN-DATE                    PIC X(10).
    11            05  ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE               PIC X(10).

### then[1]: The account's current-cycle credit and current-cycle debit are both set to 0. This happens even when the interest total is zero.
fields=['ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT'] literals=['0']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   349       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   350        1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT.
   351       * Update the balances in account record to reflect posted trans.
   352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
>> 353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   355 
   356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
   357            IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS  = '00'
   358                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT

### then[2]: The updated account record overwrites the existing account record in the account file.
fields=['FD-ACCTFILE-REC', 'ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
   353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   355 
>> 356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
   357            IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS  = '00'
   358                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   359            ELSE
   360                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

### then[3]: When the read hits end of file, the account update (1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT) still runs once more for the last account group, so its interest total is added to its current balance, its cycle credit and debit are set to 0, and its account record is rewritten like every other account.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['Y', 'N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   184            PERFORM 0200-DISCGRP-OPEN.
   185            PERFORM 0300-ACCTFILE-OPEN.
   186            PERFORM 0400-TRANFILE-OPEN.
   187 
>> 188            PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
>> 189                IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
>> 190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
>> 191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
CBACT04C.cbl:
   215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
   216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
   217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
>> 219                ELSE
>> 220                     PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
>> 221                END-IF
>> 222            END-PERFORM.
   223 
   224            PERFORM 9000-TCATBALF-CLOSE.
   225            PERFORM 9100-XREFFILE-CLOSE.
   226            PERFORM 9200-DISCGRP-CLOSE.
CBACT04C.cbl:
   335            END-IF
   336            IF  APPL-AOK
   337                CONTINUE
   338            ELSE
>> 339                IF  APPL-EOF
>> 340                    MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE
   341                ELSE
   342                    DISPLAY 'ERROR READING TRANSACTION CATEGORY FILE'
   343                    MOVE TCATBALF-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
   344                    PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 467 adds WS-MONTHLY-INT to WS-TOTAL-INT, and line 169 declares WS-TOTAL-INT as PIC S9(09)V99."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 194-196 perform 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT only when TRANCAT-ACCT-ID differs from WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM and WS-FIRST-TIME is not 'Y'."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 352 adds WS-TOTAL-INT to ACCT-CURR-BAL, which the copybook declares as PIC S9(10)V99."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 353-354 move 0 to both cycle fields unconditionally, so this happens regardless of the interest total."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 356 rewrites FD-ACCTFILE-REC from ACCOUNT-RECORD, overwriting the existing account record."},{"clause":"then[3]","supported":false,"reason":"When the read at line 190 hits EOF, END-OF-FILE becomes 'Y', the inner IF fails and the PERFORM UNTIL loop ends before the ELSE at 219-220 can run, so 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT is not executed for the last account group."}]}
